You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    prs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if g[r][c]:
                v=g[r][c]; s=c
                while c<W and g[r][c]==v: c+=1
                prs.append((r,s,v,c-s-1))
            else: c+=1
    patcells=set()
    for r,s,v,n in prs:
        for j in range(n+1): patcells.add((r,s+j))
    seeds=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in patcells]
    for r,c,v in seeds:
        # find cycle containing v
        cand=[p for p in prs if p[2]==v]
        if not cand: continue
        L=cand[0][3]; Ci=cand[0][2]
        phase=[k for k in range(L) if Ci[k]==v][0]
        best=None
        for b in range(-W,W+1):
            if b>c or b+L-1<c: continue
            if (c-b)%L!=phase: continue
            lf=sum(1 for j in range(c-b+1) if j<b and 0<=b+j<W and out[r][b+j]==0)
            # also count right fill potential
            tf=lf+sum(1 for j in range(b+c-b+1, b+L) if b+j<W and out[r][b+j]==0)
            key=(-tf, -lf) if False else (lf, -b)  # maximize left fill, tie -> rightmost
            if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,b)
        b=best[1]
        for j in range(b,b+L):
            if 0<=j<W: out[r][j]=Ci[(j-b+phase)%L]
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    prs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if g[r][c]!=0:
                v=g[r][c]; s=c
                while c<W and g[r][c]==v: c+=1
                prs.append((r,s,v,c-s))
            else: c+=1
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==0: continue
            # skip if v appears in a multi-run (it's part of a pattern block, keep original)
            inrun=False
            for rr,ss,V,n in prs:
                if V==v and c>=ss and c<ss+n: inrun=True
            if inrun: continue
            cands=[p for p in prs if p[2]==v]
            if not cands: cands=[min(prs,key=lambda p:(abs(p[0]-r),p[1]))]
            _,s,V,n=cands[0]
            ph=[j for j in range(n) if (s+j)%n==j and V==v][0] if False else None
            # phase: index of v in cycle, treat run as cyclic; find any j with run value V and v==V -> use 0? need actual offset
            # v may repeat; pick first occurrence relative to start
            offs=[j for j in range(n) if g[r][s+j]==v]
            off=offs[0] if offs else 0
            start=c-off
            def cycle(j): return V[(j-start)%n] if (j-start)%n<n else V[((j-start)-n)%n]
            changed=False
            # fill right
            k=1
            while True:
                jj=c+k
                if jj>=W: break
                nv=V[((start+(k+off)) ) % n]
                if out[r][jj]!=0: break
                if nv==v: break
                out[r][jj]=nv; k+=1
            # fill left
            k=1
            while True:
                jj=c-k
                if jj<0: break
                nv=V[(off-k)%n]
                if out[r][jj]!=0: break
                if nv==v: break
                out[r][jj]=nv; k+=1
            changed=True
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); O=[r[:] for r in g]
    runs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if g[r][c]!=0:
                v=g[r][c]; s=c
                while c<W and g[r][c]==v: c+=1
                runs.append((r,s,v,c-s))
            else: c+=1
    for sr in range(H):
        for sc in range(W):
            v=g[sr][sc]
            if v==0: continue
            cand=[p for p in runs if p[2]==v and not (p[0]==sr and p[1]<=sc<p[1]+p[3])]
            if not cand: continue
            R=max(cand,key=lambda p:p[3])
            _,s,n=R[1],R[3],R[2]
            seq=[g[sr][s+i] for i in range(n)]
            ph=(sc-s)%n
            lo=sc-ph
            for k in range(-n,n+1):
                j=lo+k
                if 0<=j<W and O[sr][j]==0:
                    O[sr][j]=seq[(ph+k)%n]
    return O
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    o=f(G[k+' input']); e=G[k+' output']
    diff=[(i,j,o[i][j],e[i][j]) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]!=e[i][j]]
    print(k, diff[:10], len(diff))

def fills(k):
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    runs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if gi[r][c]!=0:
                v=gi[r][c]; s=c
                while c<W and gi[r][c]==v: c+=1
                runs.append((r,s,v,c-s))
            else: c+=1
    out={}
    for sr in range(H):
        for sc in range(W):
            v=gi[sr][sc]
            if v==0: continue
            cand=[p for p in runs if p[2]==v and not (p[0]==sr and p[1]<=sc<p[1]+p[3])]
            if not cand: continue
            R=max(cand,key=lambda p:p[3]); n=R[3]
            seq=list(R[0][0] if False else [])
            _,s,n_=R[1],R[3],R[2]
            seq=[gi[sr][s+i] for i in range(n_)]
            # expected filled cells in output row (changed from input)
            ch=[j for j in range(W) if gi[sr][j]==0 and go[sr][j]!=0]
            vals=[go[sr][j] for j in ch]
            out[(sr,sc)]=(v,n,seq,ch,vals)
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    a=fills(k)
    print('====',k)
    for kk,(v,n,seq,ch,vals) in sorted(a.items()):
        print(' seed',(kk[0],kk[1]),'v=',v,'runlen',n,'seq',seq,'filled',ch,'vals',vals)

    runs=[]

                runs.append((r,s,v,c-s))
            else: c+=1
    out={}
    for sr in range(H):
        for sc in range(W):
            v=gi[sr][sc]
            if v==0: continue
            same_row=[p for p in runs if p[0]==sr and p[2]==v and abs(p[1]-sc)>0]
